## Where the spending wall hits

- **Claude Code (Pro $20):** Claude Pro covers Claude Code usage with shared usage limits across Anthropic's product family. Anthropic's pricing page documents Pro/Max/Max-20x but does not publish absolute Pro caps in tokens or requests; Max 5x and Max 20x are described as "5x" and "20x" of Pro respectively [1]. Real-world reports describe Max 20x as "the recommended tier for full-time Claude Code users."

- **Cursor (Pro $20):** The June 2025 pricing change replaced "500 fast requests + unlimited slow requests" with a $20 usage credit billed at API rates [10]. Heavy agent users on Anthropic models reported running through credits in days; CEO Michael Truell apologized publicly and offered refunds [10]. Pro+ at $60 advertises "3x usage on all OpenAI, Claude, Gemini models"; Ultra at $200 advertises 20x [7].

- **GitHub Copilot (Pro $10):** Premium request quotas are hard caps. Pro = 300 premium requests/month; overage $0.04/request [12]. **As of April 20, 2026 the Pro and Pro+ signup is paused** — an individual cannot sign up for Pro today [12][13]. Existing subscribers can keep their plans. The blog reasoning: "Agentic workflows have fundamentally changed Copilot's compute demands" [13]. Refunds for Pro/Pro+ unused time available through May 20, 2026 [13].

- **Gemini Code Assist Individual (free):** 1,000 requests per user per day [17]. This is shared across Gemini CLI and Code Assist agent mode. Higher quotas (1,500/day Standard, 2,000/day Enterprise) require paid Google AI Pro/Ultra subscriptions or enterprise contracts [17].

- **Antigravity (preview free):** "Weekly-based rate limits" trigger after "2-3 hours of intensive use" [19]. Pro subscribers ($19.99) report "7-day and even 10-day lockouts" against advertised "every 5 hours" refresh — described by a quoted user as "being charged for a bus pass and finding the bus doesn't run" [19]. Antigravity is materially cheaper than Claude Code for accessing Claude Opus 4.6 specifically, with reliability tradeoffs [19].

- **Windsurf (Pro $20):** "Windsurf introduced new usage-based plans for self-serve customers in March 2026" [25]. Add-on credits for Enterprise: $40 for 1,000 pooled credits; monthly credits don't roll over [25]. Pro and Max free-tier specifics not surfaced in this fetch — the publicly visible pricing page lists Pro $20 / Max $200 with "unlimited" usage labels but does not detail per-message caps [21].

- **IBM Bob (Pro $20 + $3 support):** Bobcoins are the unit of consumption. 1 Bobcoin ≈ $0.50 USD if exceeding monthly allowance [29]. Per-action costs reported by Nick Litten: simple explanations 0.1-0.5 coins; full program modernization 2-5; documentation generation 1-3; CLI workflows 5-10 per run [29]. At 40 coins/month included on Pro, a single user doing 5-10 CLI workflow runs would exhaust the bundle.

## Counter-perspectives on individual pricing

- The Cursor June 2025 pricing change was followed by a CEO apology and refunds — the most documented pricing controversy of any platform in this comparison [10].
- Anthropic's silent April 22, 2026 attempt to move Claude Code from $20 Pro to Max-only ($100-200) was reverted within hours after public pushback led by Simon Willison's blog post [5]. Willison: "A 5x price increase (from $20 to $100+) would exclude most users from his educational efforts."
- IBM Bob has a public community thread titled "Bob Billing Bonkers" reporting unexpected burn rates, though specific dollar amounts in the thread were not extracted in this research run.
- A Medium post claims Cursor's effective price rose 20× for long-context / agentic workflows after the June 2025 change [referenced via 10].

## Currency and pricing-stability notes

- Cursor: Pro+ $60 confirmed against the live `cursor.com/pricing` page on April 26, 2026 [7]. Earlier 2025 third-party coverage that listed only Hobby/Pro/Business/Ultra is outdated.
- GitHub Copilot Pro: list price $10/mo confirmed against official docs [12]; some third-party coverage cites $19/mo, which conflates it with Business ($19/seat).
- Windsurf: Discovery surface mentioned a $15→$20 Pro price hike in March 2026; the live windsurf.com/pricing page shows $20 Pro [21]. The "$15 Pro" figure is historical.
- Antigravity: $19.99 (not "$20") confirmed [19].
